title: Mitoshi
shortDescription: Call BTC, ETH, SOL and US stocks UP or DOWN. On Tempo testnet, test dollars.
fullDescription:
Call where a price closes. Pick an asset, call UP or DOWN, and the Window settles on a signed oracle print.

• BTC, ETH and SOL in 5-minute Windows, around the clock.
• Nine US stocks (AAPL, AMD, AMZN, GOOGL, META, MSFT, NVDA, PLTR, TSLA) in 5, 15 and 60-minute Windows.
• Sign up with a passkey. No seed phrase, no extension.
• One tap to trade from your Trading Balance.
• Every Window keeps its proof: both signed prints and the verdict, re-checkable in your browser. Receipts link to the chain.

Testnet: Mitoshi runs on Tempo's testnet (Moderato). The money is test pathUSD from the faucet. It has no value and can't be bought or sold. Not investment advice.
releaseNotes: Sign up with a passkey, get test dollars, call BTC UP or DOWN on a 5-minute Window, watch it settle.
